title: How to Install a Winch in GTA 6 to Steal ATMs
description: Learn how to install a winch on your vehicle in GTA 6. According to GameRant, it is the only way to yank ATMs out of the wall and steal massive cash.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Master the Art of Vehicle Customization in GTA 6

Vehicle customization has always been a core pillar of the Grand Theft Auto experience, and the upcoming release is no exception. Recent reports from gaming media outlet GameRant have shed light on a particularly exciting utility feature coming to the game: the vehicle winch.

## The Ultimate Tool for ATM Robberies

According to the report, installing a winch on your vehicle in GTA 6 is the only way to yank ATMs out of the wall and get away with a ton of money. This mechanic introduces a new layer of physics-based crime to the open world, allowing players to execute high-stakes heists on the fly without needing a complex multi-stage setup.

While traditional robberies often rely on firearms and intimidation, the addition of a heavy-duty winch turns everyday vehicles into portable demolition tools. Whether you are driving a rugged off-roader or a modified muscle car, having the right pulling power could mean the difference between a successful getaway and a police lockdown.

## Preparing for the Heist Lifestyle

Although full details regarding the exact modification shops and financial costs are yet to be detailed by Rockstar Games, the presence of winches suggests that players will need to carefully select their utility upgrades alongside performance parts. Analysis suggests that balancing speed with utility will be essential for modern criminals navigating the streets of Leonida.

## Editor's Take

The addition of functional winches for environment interaction highlights Rockstar's commitment to immersive gameplay. Combining vehicle physics with lucrative street crimes like yanking ATMs adds incredible emergent fun to the open world. It is shaping up to be a fan-favorite feature for chaotic sessions.
